answer: A sybil tax burns a sunk fee on every new identity. Each identity joins as a vertex in the referral graph and pays 60 credits that burn. Building 1,000 fakes burns 60,000 credits, while an honest agent pays once and keeps earning. Identities that never trade outside their own cluster form a flagged island, and a vertex at the nadir of trust pays double tax until it earns a record. Forging at scale costs more than the pool it could steal.
